title: AI Engineer
summary: Build reliable LLM and agent products: retrieval, tools, evals, cost and safety. Deep on M10–M12, M16–M18; M13/M14 and the M15 deep branch are optional depth. System design (M22) follows serving (M17).
outcomes: Ship an LLM application with retrieval, structured output and an eval suite that gates changes.
Build a bounded agent from raw API calls with MCP tools, durable state, approvals, traces and cost-per-success reporting.
Design LLM systems (RAG, agents, serving) with capacity, latency, cost, evaluation and failure modes in a 45-minute interview.
Threat-model and red-team an LLM/agent system against the OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10s.
Deploy and operate the app with CI/CD, containers, monitoring and a rollback path.

portfolio.title: Evaluated RAG product with a retrieval ablation
portfolio.evidence: Repo with eval set, recall@k/answer-quality table across ≥ 2 retrieval variants, cost/latency table, failure gallery.

portfolio.title: Bounded, observable, interoperable agent (M12 capstone)
portfolio.evidence: Plain-Python core + framework port, MCP server, skill, subagents, checkpoint/resume, approvals, OTel traces, 40-task eval with pass^k, cost per success, threat model.

portfolio.title: One shipped app with real users
portfolio.evidence: Public URL, usage/feedback numbers, deployment runbook, CI badge, monitoring screenshot.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: Everything the AI Engineer needs plus customer-facing delivery: discovery, scoping, enterprise integration (OAuth, webhooks, data sync), deployment in constrained/offline environments, co-built evals and communication. M19 FDE practice is core; M03 backend/auth and M16 deployment go deep.
outcomes: Run discovery with a real user and produce an evidence-labelled workflow map and outcome frame.
Write a signed scope with baseline metric, guardrails, out-of-scope items and a cost estimate.
Integrate an AI system with an existing customer system via OAuth APIs, signed idempotent webhooks and incremental sync.
Deploy an assistant offline/on-prem with open weights and a runbook a customer IT person can follow.
Co-build a user-labelled eval set, fix the top failure modes and present an honest readout and demo.

portfolio.title: Client engagement case study (M19 capstone)
portfolio.evidence: Discovery notes → signed scope → integration with an existing system → deployment in a constrained environment → user-labelled eval → adoption/impact numbers.

portfolio.title: Demo video and written handover/runbook
portfolio.evidence: 5-minute demo including a failure case, ADRs, weekly status updates, a runbook a stranger can operate.

portfolio.title: Bounded agent (M12 capstone)
portfolio.evidence: Same evidence as the AI Engineer agent item.

title: MLOps / ML Platform Engineer
summary: Make training and serving reproducible, observable, cheap and safe. DevOps (M21) early, classic MLOps (M16) right after M07–M08, then LLM apps, serving (M17) and system design (M22). M12/M15 at awareness depth; M19 FDE practice optional.
outcomes: Build a versioned data/model pipeline with CI/CD, experiment tracking, a registry and canary/rollback.
Benchmark and optimise model serving (p95 latency, throughput, cost) on CPU/GPU.
Operate monitoring, drift detection and alerting, and run an incident drill with a blameless postmortem.
Provision infrastructure as code on one cloud and run workloads on Kubernetes.
Design ML platform components (feature store, training, serving, gateway) in a system-design interview.

portfolio.title: Pipeline with data/model versioning, CI/CD, canary and rollback
portfolio.evidence: Repo with pipeline DAG, versioned data/model artifacts, CI/CD workflow, a recorded rollback.

portfolio.title: Serving benchmark with an optimisation
portfolio.evidence: Load-test report (p50/p95, throughput, cost per 1k requests) before/after an optimisation (batching, quantisation, caching).

portfolio.title: Monitoring, drift and alerting with an incident drill
portfolio.evidence: Dashboards, drift report, alert rules, runbook and postmortem of a drill.
